title: Removing the Parts field writes a log entry
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: An open work order has different Labor and Parts representatives; you remove the Parts field and look at its log.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and Labor reads {Sales-rep-A} and Parts reads {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Parts".
  2. Open the work order's menu.
  3. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 2: the work order's menu opens.
  • Step 3: the newest entry reads "Sales Representative: {Sales-rep-B} (Parts) · {Sales-rep-A} (Labor) → {Sales-rep-A}".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11271 (Story 7, Record representative changes in the work order log)

  • S7-R1: “Each change to a work order's representatives, including adding or removing the Parts field, writes one log entry, "Sales representative changed". Adding the Parts field with the same person on both sides is a change and writes one entry, for example "Sales Representative: Ann Able → Ann Able (Parts) · Ann Able (Labor)".”
  • S7-R2: “The entry shows "Sales Representative: {before} → {after}". A work order that is not split reads the one name, or "Unassigned".”
  • S7-R3: “A split work order reads both sides, Parts first: "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Elliot Brennan (Labor)". An empty side reads "Unassigned", for example "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Unassigned (Labor)".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
